provenance: Author requested mansion examples of false walls, cursed passages, fragile/living obstacles, an automaton and an alterable room. This annex is an implementation layout, with no rewards or narrative. It remains outside the original playable bounds and preserves the original TEXTMAP prefix. Corridor and room widths provide native collision clearance; door geometry reuses the existing 64-by-120-MU sliding leaf. Headroom and materials reuse the Justice room. Wheel states reuse the approved 2-m water depth and 192/32 lighting. Future example actors use this area without requiring another geometry revision.
